correctness.rationale: The frozen proof correctly expands RΔ(b)=RΔ(0)-2b E[max(Xi)-max(θi)]+b² and identifies its unique minimizer. With ordered means, the bias is E[(X1-X2)_+], X1-X2∼N(-σΔ,2σ²), so the normal positive-part identity gives σh(Δ). Direct differentiation yields h′(Δ)=-Φ(-Δ/√2)<0. Hence the boundary-versus-usual risk gap σ²[1/π-2h(Δ)/√π] crosses zero exactly once. Independent local bisection yields Δ=0.69945480190502 and the exact h(0)=1/√π; numerical root is corroborative, uniqueness is analytic.
